packageRules.description: Enforce the 7-day cooldown for npm too. config:best-practices bundles security:minimumReleaseAgeNpm, a packageRule setting minimumReleaseAge to 3 days for npm, which otherwise overrides the top-level 7 days for every npm dependency.
Group the Vite ecosystem into a single PR. @vitejs/plugin-react@6.x requires vite@^8.0.0 and vitest@4.x is needed for Vite 8 support — splitting these causes ERESOLVE peer dep conflicts.
